question: On a NEW synthetic generator that varies raw-observation delivery loss, upstream syndication between the telemetry pair and mid-outage source drift, and that charges telemetry overhead, does the UNCHANGED OBS-001 unlabelled-disagreement selector avoid a distinct important mistaken action versus BOTH fixed VOI and conservative CORE-003?

decision_before_results.GO_FOR_FURTHER_RESEARCH_ONLY: All hard gates pass. Consequence: the hypothesis may be written up as a separately reviewed OPTIONAL module design issue that requires real (non-synthetic) validation before any code enters Core. No module, test suite or CI job is merged by this study.
decision_before_results.NO_GO: Any hard gate fails. Consequence: abandon the disagreement-switch selector as a Core candidate. Do not retune thresholds, seed, regimes, costs or gates on this exposed holdout. Keep only protocol, aggregate report, doc and ADR on main.
decision_before_results.NO_GO_NOT_DISCRIMINATING: Pilot shows the candidate makes the same proposal as BOTH audit_age_only and conservative on every pilot case of every regime. Consequence: the holdout is cancelled (issue #39 item 5) and NO_GO is recorded.

new_mechanisms: raw publisher vote delivery loss and delay (available_at > observed_at) during review outage
upstream syndication: deep_root copies origin for a fraction of entities, in background telemetry AND current-case probes
drift beginning in the middle of an outage, after conservative has lost its audit history
per-decision telemetry overhead charged to the candidate whenever it reads pair telemetry
test-case shared upstream rumor during a stable outage

frozen_holdout.run_only_after: independent audit of evaluator completed and evaluator source commit recorded
frozen_holdout.seed_derivation_note: Wall-clock prereg timestamp 2026-10-18 06:15, chosen before any code; distinct from 202610121015 (OBS-001), 2026101204 (CORE-004A), 20261015 (CORE-003).

pilot.purpose: Crash, leakage and discriminability check only (issue #39 item 5).
pilot.allowed_changes_after_pilot: Bug fixes that make code match THIS protocol, each logged in the report. NEVER thresholds, seed, regimes, costs, quality tables, gates.

test_case_signals.origin_claim: always one origin observation 90 minutes before query, drawn from current origin quality
test_case_signals.pre_existing_second_root: balanced_root observation with probability 0.08 (current balanced quality)
test_case_signals.pre_existing_negative: cheap_root negative claim with probability 0.04, independent of truth

generator.probe_answers: cheap/balanced/deep answers drawn from CURRENT root quality; mirror/unlicensed forbidden probes carry truth but are never selectable
generator.quality_format: [sensitivity, specificity]; linear interpolation over ramp from onset
generator.raw_loss_definition: From outage start: each raw background vote dropped with probability 0.6; surviving votes delayed uniformly 4-20 hours (available_at = observed_at + delay).
generator.pair_syndication_definition: With the given probability per entity (background AND current-case deep probe), deep_root's vote copies origin's vote instead of an independent draw.
generator.test_rumor_definition: For a false current case, with the given probability the origin claim and all three approved probe answers are True (one shared upstream rumor).

candidate_rule_unchanged_from_obs_001.rule: If no completed review exists or its age <=8h: conservative. Else if >=18 distinct background entities have DELIVERED votes from both roots observed within the last 12h and disagreement <=0.35: fixed_voi. Else conservative.
candidate_rule_unchanged_from_obs_001.audit_age_only_control: If completed review age >8h: fixed_voi; else conservative.
candidate_rule_unchanged_from_obs_001.vote_visibility: A raw vote is policy-visible only if observed_at in [as_of-12h, as_of] AND available_at <= as_of. Latest observed vote per (root, entity). Votes carry no truth field.
candidate_rule_unchanged_from_obs_001.review_pulse_visibility: Only the latest adjudicated_at <= as_of. Reviewer outcomes never visible to the selector.

accounting.utility: (+1 correct assertion, -4 false assertion, 0 abstain) - normalized check cost - telemetry cost
accounting.telemetry_cost_note: Charged to unlabelled_disagreement on every decision where review age >8h (it reads pair telemetry), regardless of outcome. Real cost UNKNOWN; break-even cost is reported descriptively, not gated.

hard_gates_all_required.G1_primary_beats_both: outage_midstream_drift: utility(candidate) - utility(fixed_voi) >= 0.025 AND utility(candidate) - utility(conservative) >= 0.025, net of telemetry cost.
hard_gates_all_required.G2_primary_paired_interval: outage_midstream_drift: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 for candidate minus fixed_voi AND for candidate minus conservative.
hard_gates_all_required.G3_distinct_mistakes_avoided: outage_midstream_drift: false_assertions(candidate) < false_assertions(fixed_voi) AND missed_true(candidate) < missed_true(conservative).
hard_gates_all_required.G4_stable_recovery: outage_stable: utility(candidate) - utility(conservative) >= 0.025 net of telemetry AND false_assertions(candidate) <= false_assertions(fixed_voi).
hard_gates_all_required.G5_raw_loss_safe_fallback: outage_raw_loss_drift: utility(conservative) - utility(candidate) <= 0.01 AND false_assertions(candidate) <= false_assertions(conservative).
hard_gates_all_required.G6_syndication_harm_cap: outage_syndicated_drift: utility(conservative) - utility(candidate) <= 0.05 (same per-case degraded regret cap as OBS-001).
hard_gates_all_required.G7_healthy_no_change: healthy_midstream_drift: candidate proposals identical to conservative on every case.
hard_gates_all_required.G8_rumor_no_net_harm: outage_shared_rumor: utility(candidate) >= utility(conservative) AND false_assertions(candidate) <= false_assertions(fixed_voi).
hard_gates_all_required.G9_alarm_recall: outage_midstream_drift, steps >= 180: fraction of decisions with alarm (disagreement >0.35) >= 0.5.
hard_gates_all_required.G10_stable_false_alarm: outage_stable, steps >= 48: fraction of decisions with alarm <= 0.25.

reported_not_gated: extra false assertions of candidate vs conservative in every regime
decisions with insufficient pairs per regime
learning ledger: observed result -> engineering decision -> research time -> open question

cost_and_expected_value_before_run.estimated_engineering_time: one working session (design, evaluator, independent audit, report)
cost_and_expected_value_before_run.why_uncertainty_remains: OBS-001 used one simulator family with raw votes always delivered, independent pair roots and zero telemetry cost; its stable-outage gain equalled audit-age-only.

leakage_rules: Policy-visible View has no truth and no hidden probe answers.
Selector inputs: ObservedVote(root, entity, observed_at, available_at, supports) and the latest completed adjudication timestamp only.
Background entities never equal current case entities.
Audits enter conservative only when adjudicated_at <= as_of.
Votes with available_at > as_of must be invisible even if observed earlier.

audit_requirements.mutant_tests: Each of these injected faults must be caught by the OBS-002 targeted tests: truth exposed in ObservedVote; available_at filter removed; current case entity included in telemetry; reviewer outcome visible to selector; telemetry cost not charged; threshold altered.

disposition_rule: Regardless of verdict, the experimental evaluator and its targeted tests are preserved in a branch commit for replay and removed from the final tree, following ADR-0028/0029/0030. Main receives protocol, aggregate report, doc and ADR-0031.
